name: frankentty-video
description: Remotion project for the FrankenTTY demo video. Separate from the root package; never imported by src/.

scripts.studio: npm run prebuild && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run prebuild && remotion render src/index.ts FrankenTTYDemo ../build/render.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p
